# Maxnova & Luci Global

> MAXNOVA & LUCI GLOBAL LLC is a Florida limited liability company, formed in April 2026, that builds and operates its own software products for Latin America, DypOS, moyiq and Esmalia, and builds AI software for other companies. It also shares operating experience with Latin American companies entering the US market (not legal or tax advice).

Facts: Florida document number L26000222229, filed 2026-04-20, effective 2026-04-21. Founder: Walter La Madriz, telecommunications engineer. Reach: companies and people across Latin America, from the United States. Contact: hola@maxnovaluci.com. Updated: 2026-11-20.

How we make money: subscriptions to our own products, and custom projects quoted in writing. We do not sell data.

## Products
- [Products overview](https://maxnovaluci.com/products/): prices, demos, live status and current limits ([español](https://maxnovaluci.com/es/productos/)).
- [DypOS](https://www.dypos.app/): point of sale, kitchen, inventory and daily profit for restaurants and cafés. From US$49/month.
- [moyiq](https://moyiq.app/) (formerly MOY IQ): private personal finance app, no bank connection. Free plan; Pro US$4.99/month or US$39.99/year.
- [Esmalia](https://esmalia.com/): scheduling, patient chart with odontogram and daily cash for dental clinics. From US$19.99/month.
